firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Concrete you can check with a tape measure.' in 2 lines, kicker names Mesa AZ + services, lead names East Valley, primary 'Build your spec' + outlined call, Sample rating tagged, next paper band peeks ~70px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, numeral+spec list, both CTAs and status above the fold, sticky Call/Text/Spec bar. Hero status line is a middle-dot meta string in small grey mono and the desktop rail is a cryptic tick column (-0.5 each from a 10).

distinctiveness.notes: Signature visible in hero (1440-first.jpg stratified '6' with dim callouts), core-sample story (1440-scroll-25.jpg), estimator plan drawing, contact spec sheet and footer receipt (1440-full.jpg). Dark Oswald look clearly differs from concrete A (A/qa/screens/1440-first.jpg), but A also leads with a rebar-on-chairs cross-section and a numbered base/steel spec list: same thesis, different skin (-0.5). Mono tracked-caps kicker over every section heading is a template tell (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg/1440-scroll-50.jpg: Oswald condensed caps at real scale, Outfit body >=16px, tabular numbers in estimator (1440-full.jpg ~y5500). Deductions: three mono voices in one view (kicker, spec labels, status line) on 1440-first.jpg; mono micro-labels on every section and in every table row (1440-scroll-50.jpg GRIP/JULY UNDERFOOT); middle-dot meta strings in hero status and footer receipt (1440-full.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: tone run paper/deep/sunset/paper/mid/deep/paper/mid/paper/deep/amber/deep alternates well; service-area/footer collision fixed by amber contact band. Deductions: dead space - services left column empty for ~480px under its heading (1440-scroll-75.jpg), estimator left column gap of ~180px between intro and sliders (1440-full.jpg ~y5150), lone dimension line on an empty dark strip under the sunset (1440-full.jpg ~y5030).

photo.notes: Drawn treatments judged on merit: core sample cylinder (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and stratified hero numeral (1440-first.jpg) are strong and on-topic; schematic map honest ('Schematic, not to scale'). Weak: broom swatch is a 615x460 field of plain vertical stripes with nothing to read (1440-scroll-50.jpg); sunset break is flat clip-art mountains + disc (1440-full.jpg ~y4600-5000) below the craft of the core sample.

copy.notes: 1440-first.jpg h1 is concrete and checkable; 1440-scroll-25.jpg 'Hit caliche? You see the rock'; reviews quote numbers (1440-full.jpg reviews), guarantee matches facts.json and carries Sample terms; every price/rating/review labelled. Small tells: 'Price it ->' arrow repeated on all 8 rows and 01-08 numbering (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: 3-line h1, CTAs full width, 48px sticky bar with live 'Spec 4/8'. 390-full.jpg: estimator, finish tabs (2x2), spec sheet and form stack cleanly; render.json shows no overflow at 320 or 390. Minor: ~60px bone strip below the footer at the very end of 390-full.jpg.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section and word. Contrast failure: inactive core-sample label 'GRADE' renders ~#3a3d42 on #1c1f23 (well under 3:1) in 1440-scroll-25.jpg (mustFix, caps at 8). Hero status mono grey on deep is borderline small text (1440-first.jpg).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: pinned core sample with active layer callout lit amber and the matching rail tick highlighted - story and signature move together. Story steps leave 400-600px of empty dark between layers (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-full.jpg ~y3700-4300), so the scroll feels long for five lines; rest of page reads as standard reveals in the static frames (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg).

wow.notes: Connected system lands at the close: contact spec sheet with set/unset lines and the footer 'Your slab' receipt (1440-full.jpg bottom, 390-full.jpg bottom). But on desktop the rail is a thin unlabeled tick column showing '4/8' before the visitor has chosen anything (1440-first.jpg), so the accumulation never feels earned or visible mid-page.

polish.notes: Consistent 2px radius, one stroke weight, dashed 'add to spec' buttons used everywhere (1440-full.jpg reviews). Deductions: a bone 56x72px square sits above the dark rail at top-right whenever the header leaves (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg); bone strip under the mobile footer (390-full.jpg).

mustFix.problem: Inactive layer label 'GRADE' (and other dimmed callouts) render near-invisible, ~1.5:1 on the deep background: text contrast failure
mustFix.fix: Give inactive callouts at least #8a8f98 on #1c1f23 (>=4.5:1 for 14px mono) and show the active state with amber + weight instead of dimming the rest

elevate.move: Bring every drawn surface up to the core-sample's craft: make each finish swatch a measured specimen (a cut tile with edge profile, aggregate scale and a dim-line for texture depth) and rebuild the July break as a section-line drawing of the pour at dawn (truck, chute, slab, thermometer callout) instead of flat mountains and a sun disc

Redesign the story's active/inactive grammar so state is carried by colour, weight and a filled marker on the dim-line rather than by fading the other layers, and let the rail mirror that same marker, so every label stays readable at every scroll position
